title: PaidBench.__init__ puts a failing claude shim on PATH around Bench.__init__, which no longer starts claude, and its docstring says Bench reads the version there
goal: bench_load.PaidBench no longer builds a failing claude shim around Bench.__init__, and its docstring names where the paid run's version stays ? (benchmarks.main presets it), since Bench.__init__ starts no claude

run: import sys,tempfile; sys.path.insert(0,'_tools'); import bench_load; n=[]; o=bench_load.shim_dir; bench_load.shim_dir=lambda d: (n.append(1), o(d))[1]; bench_load.PaidBench(tempfile.mkdtemp(),1); sys.exit(1 if n else 0)
